en: The image shows a vintage postcard. The front features a black-and-white panoramic photograph of a harbor with several buildings, ships, and a view of the water, with the caption 'Sundsvall. Hamnen.' at the top left. The reverse displays handwritten text, address lines, a postage information box in Swedish, and a postmark. The word 'Stockholm' and 'SVENSKA LITOGRAFISKA AB' can be seen, suggesting a Swedish origin.
